description: Inkable Label Co.: send a quote request to our team for your user: custom labels, custom tissue paper, or custom pouches and bags, with the questions from our quote forms. We email your user a confirmation link first; the request reaches our team only after they confirm it themselves (don't click it for them). Our team reviews it; if it's something we can make, we reply by email with a written quote or a question about the spec. No reply time is given. For roll labels, sheet labels and tissue paper in the online options, inkable_price gives the website price instead. Requires customer_consent=true. Returns a reference number. Does not create an order.

add_ons.description: Add-ons for this bag type. Leave empty for none.
add_ons.title: Add Ons

bag_type.description: What kind of packaging bag. For another style, pick custom and describe it in custom_style.
bag_type.title: Bag Type

bottom_gusset_print.description: For stand-up pouches: true if the design prints on the bottom gusset.
bottom_gusset_print.title: Bottom Gusset Print

custom_style.description: For custom: the bag style, e.g. 'gable top bag for cereal'.
custom_style.title: Custom Style

design_breakdown.description: For more than one design: the quantity per design, e.g. '1,000 of A + 2,000 of B'.
design_breakdown.title: Design Breakdown

edges.description: For pillow pouches: plain or serrated edges.
edges.title: Edges

fill_volume.description: How much goes in each bag, e.g. '8 oz of macaroni' or an estimated volume. Ask the customer; don't guess.
fill_volume.title: Fill Volume

material.description: Bag material. For anything else pick other and give material_other.
material.title: Material

material_other.description: For other: the material wanted, e.g. 'PET/AL/LDPE'.
material_other.title: Material Other

open_side.description: For pillow and flat pouches: the side left open for filling.
open_side.title: Open Side

print_colors.description: Number of print colors, or not_sure.
print_colors.title: Print Colors

product.description: What product goes in the bag, e.g. 'coffee beans'.
product.title: Product

seal_location.description: For pillow pouches: where the back seal goes.
seal_location.title: Seal Location

size.description: Bag size with units: width x height x depth (flat pouches: width x height). Leave out if the customer isn't sure.
size.title: Size

special_instructions.description: Special instructions, e.g. spot matte areas or clear windows.
special_instructions.title: Special Instructions

tear_notches.description: For pillow pouches with plain edges: tear notches.
tear_notches.title: Tear Notches

is_ai_agent.description: True if an AI agent is submitting on the customer's behalf.
is_ai_agent.title: Is Ai Agent

agent.description: Who is submitting: is_ai_agent and the agent's name.

bags.description: Pouch and bag details (the bag quote form): bag_type, product and fill_volume are required.

customer_consent.description: True only if the customer asked for this quote and agreed to be emailed by Inkable Label.
customer_consent.title: Customer Consent

customer_email.description: Where we send the confirmation link, then the written quote.
customer_email.title: Customer Email

labels.description: Label details (the label quote form). All optional.

notes.description: Any special requests, in the customer's words.
notes.title: Notes

postcode.description: Postal code the order ships to, if known.
postcode.title: Postcode

product_type.description: Which quote form: labels, tissue (custom tissue paper) or bags (pouches and bags). Put the matching details in labels, tissue or bags.
product_type.title: Product Type

quantities.description: Total quantity per quote option, e.g. [1000, 2500]. Ask the customer; don't guess.
quantities.title: Quantities

ship_to_country.description: Country the order ships to, if not the US. Free shipping to the US; outside the US, ask us.
ship_to_country.title: Ship To Country

tissue.description: Custom tissue paper details (the tissue quote form). All optional.

corner_radius.description: For custom_radius corners: the radius, if the customer knows it.
corner_radius.title: Corner Radius

corners.description: For square and rectangle labels: how should the corners look?
corners.title: Corners

delivery.description: How the labels come: sheets, rolls or individually cut.
delivery.title: Delivery

foil_color.description: For foil stamp: the foil color.
foil_color.title: Foil Color

foil_color_request.description: For a special_request foil color: the color wanted.
foil_color_request.title: Foil Color Request

laminate.description: For clear and holographic labels: gloss or matte laminate.
laminate.title: Laminate

material.description: What kind of label: paper, plastic film (waterproof), metallic (foil), clear, brown kraft or holographic.
material.title: Material

roll_direction.description: For rolls: which way the labels dispense off the roll.
roll_direction.title: Roll Direction

size.description: Label size with units, e.g. '3 x 2 in'.
size.title: Size

special_application.description: Special application, e.g. small tubes or extra adhesive.
special_application.title: Special Application

special_fx.description: Finishing details: foil stamp, embossing, spot UV or serial numbers/variable data.
special_fx.title: Special Fx

stock.description: For paper, plastic_film and metallic labels: the stock (see each material's options).
stock.title: Stock

variable_data.description: For variable data: what varies, e.g. serial numbers.
variable_data.title: Variable Data

custom_size.description: For a custom sheet size: width x height with units.
custom_size.title: Custom Size

ink_colors.description: Ink color values, e.g. 'PMS 286' or 'Process Black' (up to 3).
ink_colors.title: Ink Colors

ink_colors_count.description: How many ink colors: one, two, three or full color CMYK. Standard 17 GSM tissue prints one color.
ink_colors_count.title: Ink Colors Count

layout.description: How the design should appear: horizontal, vertical, not sure, or the customer's own layout.
layout.title: Layout

packaging.description: What the customer is packaging (helps us recommend the tissue stock).
packaging.title: Packaging

proof.description: Proof type: soft (a digital PDF preview) or hard (a printed sample).
proof.title: Proof

sheet_size.description: Sheet size in inches. Custom sizes are cut free: pick custom and give custom_size.
sheet_size.title: Sheet Size

stock_color.description: Tissue stock color: white, a colored stock, or metallic gold or silver.
stock_color.title: Stock Color

weight.description: Tissue weight: standard 17 GSM, medium 28-32 GSM or heavy 45-50 GSM.
weight.title: Weight
